frozen: 2026-10-29, before any new indicator was computed for any event and before any result of this study existed
owner_instruction: run it: do the research-backed price indicators, and the popular chart indicators, add anything to the one live question
question: On US stocks that just closed 30% or more higher, do (a) the price indicators with the strongest published evidence and (b) the popular chart indicators add out-of-time discrimination to LEARNER v2.3's own features, for its headline statement (the next session closes 10% lower, on its own) and its companion (the 5-session plan ends 10% down, on its own)?

events.what: the 6,225 US events of research/PATH_HISTORY_v1 (2020-2023) with v2.3's 29 features and both labels, as v2.3's warm start; nothing from 2024 on is read (the panel ends 2023-12-29)

prices.chain: every indicator reads the reference chain (cumulative close over the exchange's previous close), highs and lows scaled onto it, through the close of the signal session d

blocks.BASE: LEARNER v2.3's 29 features exactly as in the event file (P0, P1, E_US)

features.max20: the largest single-session return in the 20 sessions before d (d-20..d-1, at least 15 present): the lottery effect, Bali, Cakici & Whitelaw (2011)
features.near_high252: the level at d over its maximum over the 252 sessions ending at d (at least 200 present): George & Hwang (2004)
features.mom_12_1: the level at d-21 over the level at d-252, minus 1 (both present): Jegadeesh & Titman (1993), the 12-1 convention
features.has_year: 1 when near_high252 and mom_12_1 could be computed (the panel starts 2020-01-02, so most 2020 events have neither)

features.rsi14: Wilder's RSI over 14 sessions on the chain closes through d
features.macd_hist: (EMA12 - EMA26) - EMA9 of that difference, at d, over the level at d
features.stoch_k14: (close - lowest low) / (highest high - lowest low) over the 14 sessions ending at d

blocks.missing: an indicator that cannot be computed is 0 after scaling (RESEARCH carries has_year)

folds.note: 2023 was the test year of PATH_HISTORY_v1, whose result chose v2.3's features; BASE was chosen on it, which can only favour BASE, never the new blocks. Fold A adds a test year that chose nothing

model: penalised logistic regression per statement, block and fold: features standardised on the fold's fit rows, an unpenalised-in-effect intercept (precision 1/1.5^2), precision 16 on every slope (learner2's LAMBDA_SHARED); Newton with step-halving; nothing tuned

statements.DUMP10_5: y_DUMP10_5 of the event file (ungraded rows dropped)

metrics.auc: per fold; pooled = the folds' AUCs weighted by their numbers of positive-negative pairs
metrics.delta: paired: AUC(BASE + block) - AUC(BASE) on the same scored rows; pooled the same way
metrics.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over the ISO weeks of the signal session within each fold, 2,000 resamples, seed 20261029, the same resamples for both models; one-sided p for delta <= 0 = (resamples with pooled delta <= 0 + 1) / 2,001
metrics.brier: the pooled Brier gain of BASE + block over BASE, reported beside it

decision_rule.adds: Holm over the four at 0.05 rejects delta <= 0 and the pooled Brier gain over BASE is above zero
decision_rule.otherwise: DOES NOT ADD for that statement (a result about these indicators on this question)
decision_rule.descriptive: BASE + RESEARCH + CHART together; each indicator's standardised coefficient; the AUC of each block alone

use: a block that ADDS becomes a candidate for a separately frozen LEARNER v2.4 challenger (the RESEARCH block needs a one-year live price pull); one that does not stays out. Nothing here changes v2.3, any ledger, register or frozen protocol
counted_trial: research/QUANT_GRADE/trials/TA_HISTORY_v1.json (4 variants, Holm), the result in TA_HISTORY_v1_result.json: one trial
limitations: the 12-month indicators exist for few 2020 events, so fold A fits them on 2021 events mostly
the chart indicators at d include the spike day itself, which dominates every short window (by construction, as a chartist would see the chart that evening)
